newsitem.title: USA: Community Medical to trade on SmallCap.
newsitem.headline: Community Medical to trade on SmallCap.

text.p: Community Medical Transport Inc, a medical transportation services company, said on Thursday its common stock and warrants would begin trading on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market when the market opens on August 1.

The company said in a statement, "Although Community Medical does not agree with the decision to terminate the listing of the company's securities from the Nasdaq National Market, in the view of the Nasdaq Stock Market Inc, the company did not comply with certain Nasdaq criteria not related to the financial condition of the company."
In addition to the news about its stock listing, the company said it has signed a deal to buy Fox Ridge Transportation, of Tarrytown, N.Y., for an undisclosed amount of stock and debt.
Fox Ridge is a privately-held provider of ambulette services, with $1.8 million in annual revenues.
